digest.component_or_area: bridge runner and repair pause coordination
propositions: A runner-neutral bridge entrypoint in _bridge_runner.py must route local, GitHub Actions, Jenkins, GitLab CI, and bare environment execution through a single packaged Python core without requiring repository-local runner scripts.
Destructive-repair pause ownership must be provider-neutral and use git-based durable CAS coordination via refs/reconciler/gate without GitHub CLI dependencies.
Legacy reconcile callers using rebar reconcile --mode and checked-out workflows must retain their existing behavior, defaults, exit codes, and mutation boundaries.

The repair-pause mechanism must read existing pause snapshots via set_pause, clear only observed OIDs through release with ref_lock.GATE_REF, and prove no GitHub CLI subprocess calls with tests/scripts/graph/test_repair_pause_ownership.py.

Both fsck --repair and doctor --repair must route through the provider-neutral owned_repair_pause contract in _repair_pause.py with per-invocation repair:<surface>:<uuid4> tokens and foreign-pause abort semantics.

Local/GitHub/Jenkins/GitLab/bare bridge execution and legacy reconcile mode handling must be independently verifiable through focused regression tests that prove backward compatibility and portability across all five environments.
